title: ECM Parameter Set (ECM-PS)
description: Open, self-describing exchange format for equivalent-circuit-model parameters. A document, not an engine: it carries the values, not a simulation run. Semantically typed against emmo/domain/equivalent-circuit-model; losslessly mappable to the PyBaMM/PyBOP ECM parameter namespace. DRAFT 0.1 -- $id namespace pending the w3id/EMMO decision.

profile.description: IRI of the ECM profile / ontology class this set parameterises, e.g. https://w3id.org/emmo/domain/equivalent-circuit-model#TheveninEquivalentCircuitModel. Fixes topology + governing equations so a solver need not re-derive them.

rc_branches.description: Number of R||C branches. Maps to PyBaMM option 'number of rc elements'.

hysteresis.description: OCV hysteresis model. 'one-state' = About:Energy gamma-decay h-state. PyBaMM basic Thevenin is 'none'.

entropic.description: Whether an entropic coefficient (dU/dT) is provided. Maps to PyBaMM 'Entropic change [V/K]'.

diffusion.description: Optional Warburg-like diffusion element. Maps to PyBaMM 'Diffusion time constant [s]' + diffusion-element option.

current_sign.description: Sign of cell current. 'positive_charge' matches BDF/battfeed and the About:Energy SOC integral. PyBaMM's 'Current function [A]' is load-positive (discharge); exporters MUST flip sign accordingly.

soc_definition.description: SOC as a 0..1 fraction (BTE/PyBaMM convention; never percent).

nominal_capacity_ampere_hour.description: Q_nom. Maps to PyBaMM 'Nominal cell capacity [A.h]' and 'Cell capacity [A.h]'.

battinfo_record.description: IRI of the BattINFO cell / cell-spec record this ECM abstracts.

degradation.description: SOH overlays applied MULTIPLICATIVELY at evaluation time. BoL tables in 'parameters' stay unscaled.

series_resistance_growth_factor.description: lambda_deg_R0: applied to R0 only (About:Energy convention); other elements unscaled unless stated.

representation.description: How each parameter varies over the independent variables. 'lookup' = gridded table (the common case).

independent_variables.description: Ordered grid axes. Typically [state_of_charge, temperature_degc]; add current_ampere for PyBaMM-style 3D R/C lookups.

columns.description: Declares each dependent parameter column: name, unit, element role, RC branch index, and PyBaMM parameter name.

table.description: The gridded values. Inline (array of rows keyed by axis+column names) for small sets, or a reference to a BDF-style tabular artifact (.bdf.csv / .parquet) for real ones.

oneOf.description: Path/IRI of a BDF-convention table; one row per grid point, columns named exactly as axes + columns above.
Inline rows; each key is an axis name or a column name.

thermal.description: OPTIONAL lumped thermal network (pack/jig concern, not a cell electrical parameter). Present only to make a complete PyBaMM export possible.

initial_conditions.description: OPTIONAL simulation state, NOT cell parameters. Excluded from the semantic 'cell parameter' payload by design.

identification.description: OPTIONAL per-parameter fitting metadata, making this document a first-class PyBOP source/target. Keys are column names.

from_state.description: Derive the factor from the envelope's state.state_of_health at evaluation time.

quantity.description: EMMO/BattINFO quantity IRI, e.g. battinfo StateOfCharge / Temperature / ElectricCurrent.

name.description: BDF-convention {quantity}_{unit} snake_case, e.g. series_resistance_ohm, polarization_resistance_1_ohm, polarization_capacitance_1_farad, ocv_charge_volt, ocv_discharge_volt, entropic_coefficient_volt_per_kelvin, hysteresis_decay_rate_dimensionless.

unit.description: ohm | farad | volt | volt_per_kelvin | dimensionless | second.

role.description: Semantic role; maps to an emmo/domain/equivalent-circuit-model class.

pybamm_name.description: Exact PyBaMM parameter string, e.g. 'R0 [Ohm]', 'C1 [F]', 'Open-circuit voltage [V]', 'Entropic change [V/K]'.
